description: This file defines the class `Zend_Http_UserAgent_Email`, which is a specialized user agent detector for email clients based on a user agent string. It extends a desktop user agent class and implements methods to identify email browsers, specifically matching signatures like 'thunderbird'.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Email
classes.description: A class for detecting email client user agents, extending the Desktop user agent class and providing a specific internal method for matching email signatures.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method that determines if a user agent string matches email client signatures like Thunderbird.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'email', indicating the browser type.
